notes.title: Main menu showstopper bug fix
notes.notes: - Fixed a bug on the main menu where debug buttons were being processed invisibly. This could lead to a player getting stuck and needing to force quit.

notes.title: 1.01 patch
notes.notes:
- Reduced volume of deflect "ping" sound
- Reduced volume of bomb explosions
- Bombs are now thrown with L3 so you can aim with the right stick

Thanks everyone.
